why_superseded: V1 and V2 both listed generated artifacts as frozen authority. A full write-target audit removed all 34 of them, so the frozen set — and its aggregate — changed.
convention: ★ Follows the existing STMX baseline convention (CIRP_EI_PARK_V1): a governance directory carrying a `repo/` mirror at exact repo-relative paths. ⛔ No new freeze architecture was invented.
manifest_excluded_from_its_own_hash_list: MANIFEST.json cannot contain its own hash; it is excluded and the aggregate covers every other frozen file.
⛔_no_manifest_entry_is_a_write_target: Proved statically (writer scan over every runnable file in the frozen set) and dynamically (fs write-API interception across the whole workload). ⛔ Byte-stability is explicitly NOT accepted as proof of immutability.
⛔_immutability: No runtime-generated artifact may overwrite a frozen file. No test may modify a frozen file. Every frozen file is set read-only, and §16 proves byte-identity after a full production + regression + provenance + guard run.
